environment.description: AWS Lambda (Node.js 18.x) behind API Gateway with Cognito authorizer. PostgreSQL 14 on RDS where the connection role is tenant-scoped via IAM RDS authentication (each Lambda invocation assumes a tenant-specific IAM role mapped to a Postgres role). The customers table has ROW LEVEL SECURITY enabled with policy: CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON customers USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant')::uuid) WITH CHECK (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant')::uuid). The DB role has FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY set. However, the format string vulnerability in util.format still exists and the log_ref is still returned in the response body. Note: the RLS policy combined with pg_catalog restrictions means even if SET app.current_tenant is called with a spoofed value, the IAM-authenticated role's permission boundary restricts SET operations to the pre-authenticated tenant value via a custom event trigger: CREATE EVENT TRIGGER enforce_tenant_set ON ddl_command_start EXECUTE FUNCTION validate_tenant_context(). Additionally, a pg_settings row-level policy prevents the Lambda role from reading other session variables that might leak cross-tenant metadata.
